name: Rel Attributes Filter
description: Provides filters to add rel attributes to links in the ckeditor.
project_description:
Description 

 The Rel Attributes Filter (rel_attributes_filter) module provides filters for the ckeditor to add rel attributes to links.

Currently, three filters are supported: noreferrer, noopener and nofollow.

 This module is based on the Noopener filter module but it adds the filter for noreferrer and nofollow attributes. However, support for the hook_link_alter is not available at this time.

 Requirements 

 This module requires no modules outside of Drupal core.

 Installation 

 Install as you would normally install a contributed Drupal module. Visit https://www.drupal.org/docs/8/extending-drupal-8/installing-drupal-8-mo… for further information.

 Configuration 

 Navigate to admin/config/content/formats .

 Choose the text editor to add the filters.

 Under "enabled filters" choose the filters you'd like to apply and save the configuration
